title: Global Market: China stocks extend losing streak to 12 weeks as global AI selloff hits tech shares - The Economic Times
text:
China's CSI300 index fell to a one-year low, extending its losing streak to 12 weeks as a global AI stock selloff weighed on technology shares. The index is down 14% over 12 weeks and on track for its steepest monthly decline since July, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng advanced.
